messages:
Maya Chen: quick sync — Asteria pre-QBR check. They hit a sudden embed-heavy spike, credits draining. onboarding doc mostly done but CS notes some missing enablement sessions. can we triage risk + mitigation?
Jared Roberts: saw the spike at 09:12 UTC, ~120k embed tokens over 6 hrs, largely from /embed-bulk endpoint. link: https://app.redwood/usage/Asteria (internal)
Priya Singh: tagging renewal risk: moving them from green->amber. they asked for tighter alerts; want a concrete spend forecast for the QBR deck. can eng produce a 30/60/90 burn scenario?
Sam Ortiz: proposal: 1) add a short-term spend alert at 75% of their retainer 2) throttle embed-batch-size from 512->128 for 24h 3) enable prefix caching for chat flows. low-effort, quick wins.
Sam Ortiz: snippet for an alert rule to add in Console -> Alerts:
```
resource: customer/Asteria
metric: credits_used
window: 24h
threshold: 75%%
notify: cs-team, ops-oncall
action: auto-throttle embed-batch-size=128 (temp)
```
Jared Roberts: +1 to throttle. also recommend applying quantization profile q4_0 for their model variant to cut token cost ~20%%. will validate perf impact in staging.
Priya Singh: for QBR deck I need: current burn, 30/60/90 projection, enabled mitigations, and customer feedback notes. Maya — can you capture enablement gaps?
Maya Chen: will pull enablement notes and run a quick poll with the customer tomorrow morning. I'll own the feedback capture and add to the QBR slide.
CS-Bot: alert created: Asteria credits_used 75% threshold (1990020000) — notified #cs-ops.
Maya Chen: thanks all. owner checklist
- Sam: implement temporary throttle & caching (ETA 2h)
- Jared: validate quantization perf (ETA EOD)
- Maya: capture enablement gaps + customer poll (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Priya: assemble burn scenarios for deck (ETA EOD)
Maya Chen: will follow up here when poll done. :white_check_mark:
